boj-2026-10.standing: The Bank of Japan's policy board, which meets eight times a year to set the country's short-term interest rate. Its decisions move the yen and the yield on Japanese government debt, and reach borrowers far beyond Japan.
boj-2026-10.recent: Tokyo is debating whether Japan's inflation is now wage-driven rather than imported, the question further hikes turn on. The Bank of Japan decides two days after the Fed held with a December Fed hike fully priced, and with the yen at a one-month high on AI doubts, so the gap between Japanese and US rates is what is at stake.

boe-2026-11.standing: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee, nine members who vote eight times a year on Bank Rate. Their decision sets the price of UK mortgages and business loans, and sterling and gilt yields move with it.
boe-2026-11.recent: The Bank of England decides with the chancellor's Budget still to come, after inflation and borrowing data showed how little room the Treasury has, so the committee sets rates before it knows the fiscal stance. Iran threats have kept oil unsettled, reviving the question of whether to hike into an energy shock.

fomc-2026-12.standing: The Federal Reserve's rate-setting committee, which meets eight times a year to set the overnight rate US banks lend at. Its decisions price dollar borrowing worldwide, from American mortgages to emerging-market debt.
fomc-2026-12.recent: Warsh has called AI a shock to the economy and withheld guidance, then held rates despite intensifying inflation, with TD Securities expecting 3 dissents against the hold. December tests whether the chair can answer the credibility doubts his messaging revived, with AI financing exposed to whatever the committee decides.

g20-2026-miami.standing: The annual meeting of leaders of the world's largest economies, hosted by the member holding the rotating presidency. Its members produce about 85% of global output, and its communiqué sets shared lines on trade and debt.
g20-2026-miami.recent: The US presidency is hosting in Miami, and the guest list is already contested: Merz has urged Trump to invite South Africa. Zelenskyy has floated using the summit to meet the US and Russia, and an Emissions Gap Report named the U.S., the host setting the agenda, an outlier among G20 nations.

ecb-2026-12.standing: The European Central Bank's Governing Council, which meets eight times a year to set interest rates for the countries sharing the euro. Its deposit rate drives borrowing costs for some 350 million people, and the euro moves with it.
ecb-2026-12.recent: This is one of Lagarde's last decisions before she leaves on 7 February 2027, nine months early, with her succession now a Franco-German bargain. The council weighs an Iran war energy shock that has lifted household inflation expectations to 3.1% against France's bond strain and tightening credit, with 7% of euro zone firms already facing loan obstacles.

boe-2026-12.standing: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee, nine members who vote eight times a year on Bank Rate. Their decision sets the price of UK mortgages and business loans, and sterling and gilt yields move with it.
boe-2026-12.recent: This is the Bank of England's last scheduled rate decision of the year. It settles the rate that the country's variable mortgages, new fixed deals and savings products reprice from going into the new year.

boj-2026-12.standing: The Bank of Japan's policy board, which meets eight times a year to set the country's short-term interest rate. Its decisions move the yen and the yield on Japanese government debt, and reach borrowers far beyond Japan.
boj-2026-12.recent: Japan's inflation debate has turned to whether wages, not a weak yen, now drive prices, and that is the condition the Bank of Japan's case for further tightening rests on. It meets as markets fully price a December Fed rate hike, which would widen the gap that leaves the yen at 156.28 per dollar even at a one-month high.

fred-us-jobs-report-2026-11-06.standing: The Bureau of Labor Statistics' monthly employment report, released on the first Friday of most months, counting jobs added, the unemployment rate and wage growth. Treasury yields, the dollar and Fed rate bets reprice within minutes.
fred-us-jobs-report-2026-11-06.recent: This US jobs report settles how many jobs employers added in the latest month and where the unemployment rate stands, along with revisions to the two months before it.
